question.text: 'Surya Angel Fund' is a sub-category of Cat I VCF (Angel Fund). What is the maximum number of investors this scheme can have?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Angel Funds - a sub-category of Cat I VCF - are capped at 200 investors per scheme under SEBI (AIF) Regulations (as amended for Angel Funds). A higher cap of 1000 applies only to ordinary AIF schemes. **The Trap:** 49 is a private placement sub-cap for some securities. 1000 is the ordinary AIF cap. 'Unlimited' is wrong. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A and XIX-C both test the Angel Fund 200 cap and min investment of INR 25 lakh - these Angel-specific numbers are exam favourites. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Angel Fund LPs also have a lower minimum (INR 25 lakh vs INR 1 crore) - use this to attract early-stage HNIs but keep the cap at 200 or lose your Angel Fund status.
